claims.final_claim: In the recorded Cu(111) positive-control sequence, stable tracking yields mutually consistent pairwise Delta R/R across five heterogeneous strategies after common Gaussian refinement.
claims.rationale: The Ag-only measurement-window and capture-contract sensitivity does not alter the independently frozen Cu endpoint evidence; the existing positive-control and no-ranking boundary remains mandatory.

claims.final_claim: Across the two recorded Ag(111) energy sequences, the four case-based stress-test strata differentiate strategies through branch-consistent coverage, post-gap recovery, and geometry-inconsistent continuation under the tested measurement contracts.

global_boundary: All claims apply only under the tested measurement contracts and data regimes. The evidence establishes reproducibility and physical self-consistency of the measurement chain, not external absolute tracking accuracy, spot-identity ground truth, a universal method ranking, calibrated structural LEED I(V), or instrument-traceable detector geometry.
